articles.title: ProcArena: A Multi-Scenario Benchmark for LLMs on Direct and Interactive PL/SQL Development from Natural Language
articles.zh: ProcArena：面向自然语言直接与交互式PL/SQL开发的LLM多场景基准
articles.summary: 如果你在做数据库相关工具或研究LLM写存储过程，这个基准能告诉你模型在真实PL/SQL任务上到底几斤几两
articles.author: Hang Zhang, Chaokun Wang 等
articles.body: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong potential for translating natural-language (NL) requirements into PL/SQL programs, attracting increasing attention from the database community. However, existing NL-to-PL/SQL efforts primarily focus on directly generating PL/SQL from complete NL requirements. In practice, PL/SQL development involves diverse scenarios, such as from-scratch development, code modification, debugging, and optimization, and may require either direct generation or multi-turn interaction. Yet, no comprehensive benchmark evaluates multi-scenario, direct and interactive, and multi-dialect NL-to-PL/SQL development. In this paper, we present ProcArena, an execution-based benchmark covering both Direct and Interactive modes. ProcArena comprises 3,998 executable tasks over 157 databases, spanning nine development subscenarios in PostgreSQL and Oracle. We construct challenging Direct tasks through Iterative Logic Enhancement and scenario-specific adapters, and derive paired Interactive tasks through Knowledge Integration and Requirement Perturbation while preserving executable targets. We further design a controlled Solver-User Simulator protocol that allows models to clarify user intent and inspect the database environment without exposing hidden execution feedback. Evaluating seven language models, we find that the best average scores are only 62.2% and 57.8% in Direct and Interactive, respectively, demonstrating that realistic NL-to-PL/SQL development remains challenging, particularly in interactive settings.
articles.bodyZh:
大型语言模型（LLM）在把自然语言（NL）需求转换成PL/SQL程序方面展现了很大的潜力，这引起了数据库领域越来越多的关注。不过，现有的自然语言到PL/SQL的研究，大多只是从完整的需求描述里直接生成PL/SQL代码。但在实际开发中，PL/SQL编写远不止这一种情况——还有从零开始写代码、改代码、调试、优化等各种场景，而且有时候需要直接生成，有时候则要来回多轮对话才行。可惜的是，目前还没有一个全面的评测集，能够覆盖这么多场景、支持直接和交互两种模式、还兼顾多种数据库方言的自然语言到PL/SQL开发任务。

在这篇论文里，我们推出了ProcArena——一个基于实际执行结果的评测基准，同时支持“直接”和“交互”两种工作模式。ProcArena一共包含3,998个可执行任务，覆盖157个数据库，跨越了PostgreSQL和Oracle两个数据库系统，下面细分出九种开发子场景。我们通过“迭代逻辑增强”（Iterative Logic Enhancement）和针对具体场景的适配器，构建了很有挑战性的直接任务；再通过“知识融合”（Knowledge Integration）和“需求扰动”（Requirement Perturbation），在保留可执行目标的前提下，生成了配对的交互任务。我们另外设计了一套受控的“求解者—用户模拟器”协议，让模型既能向用户澄清需求，也能查看数据库环境，但又不会把隐藏的执行反馈直接暴露给模型。

我们评测了七款大语言模型，结果发现：在直接模式下，最佳平均得分只有62.2%；在交互模式下，更只有57.8%。这说明，在真实场景中把自然语言需求变成PL/SQL程序，仍然是个很难的任务，尤其是在交互式环境下，挑战就更大了。

articles.title: DFlow: Enabling Verifier Information Flow in Block Diffusion Speculative Decoding
articles.zh: DFlow：在块扩散投机解码中实现验证器信息流动
articles.summary: 如果你在优化LLM推理速度，这个让验证器信息参与生成的方法可能比传统投机解码更稳
articles.author: Yaojie Zhang, Linfeng Zhang 等
articles.body: Block diffusion speculative decoding improves LLM inference efficiency by proposing a block of future tokens in parallel and verifying them with a single forward pass through the target model. However, existing methods retain only the accepted prefix and discard the rejected suffix, preventing the computation spent on these positions from benefiting subsequent drafting rounds and forcing the drafter to repeatedly reconstruct representations for future tokens from scratch. We observe that rejection only determines whether a proposed token can be committed, while the verifier representations at rejected positions can still provide useful information for subsequent predictions. Based on this observation, we propose DFlow, a simple yet effective framework that enables verifier information to flow across drafting rounds. DFlow reuses the hidden states produced by the target verifier for the rejected suffix to guide subsequent drafting without additional target computation. To effectively learn this information flow across drafting rounds, we introduce a self-condition train strategy that feeds verifier representations from earlier predictions back into subsequent predictions. Experiments on Qwen3 models across diverse benchmarks demonstrate that DFlow consistently improves draft quality and acceptance length over DFlash.
articles.bodyZh: 分块扩散投机解码（Block Diffusion Speculative Decoding）通过并行提出一批未来令牌，并通过目标模型一次性前向验证，大幅提升了LLM推理效率。但现有方法有个问题：只保留被接受的前缀，丢掉被拒绝的后缀，这不仅浪费了在这些位置上已花费的计算量，还迫使草稿模型每次都得从零开始重建未来令牌的表示。我们发现，拒绝只是决定某个提议令牌能否被接受，但验证器在被拒绝位置上的表示，对后续预测依旧有参考价值。基于这一观察，我们提出了DFlow——一个简单而高效的框架，让验证器信息可以在多轮草稿生成之间流动。DFlow会复用目标验证器在被拒绝后缀上产生的隐藏状态，来指导后续草稿生成，且无需额外的目标模型计算。为了有效学习这种跨草稿轮次的信息流动，我们引入了自条件训练策略（self-condition train），把此前预测中得到的验证器表示反馈到后续预测中。在Qwen3模型上的多项基准测试中，DFlow相较DFlash在草稿质量和接受长度上均实现了一致提升。

articles.title: OracleZoom: On-Policy Self-Distillation Inspired Reference-Constrained Recursive Image Super Resolution
articles.zh: OracleZoom：基于在线自蒸馏的参考约束递归图像超分辨率
articles.summary: 如果你做图像超分或画质修复，这个用在线自蒸馏约束递归过程的路子，能减少放大时细节幻觉
articles.author: Shubhashis Roy Dipta, Sourajit Saha 等
articles.body: Recursive Super-Resolution (SR) extends fixed-scale SR to extreme magnification by repeatedly feeding predictions back into the same model, analogous to zooming an image repeatedly. However, ground truth availability at every scale, especially at depth, remains challenging as the required source resolution grows geometrically, leaving deeper predictions unsupervised. We present OracleZoom, an on-policy distillation-inspired, reference-constrained framework that trains on its trajectory while carrying the last ground-truth evidence beyond the supervision boundary. Direct and cross-scale supervision constrain verifiable content, while a no-reference quality objective guides unresolved fine-scale detail. A KL-constrained pretrained latent prior limits quality-driven drift, while EMA consistency stabilizes the supervision boundary. Across seven datasets, OracleZoom achieves the state-of-the-art SR quality across zooming scales, averaging 0.713 CLIPIQA, with larger gains on deeper scales, while significantly reducing hallucinations. Code, data, and models are available at https://dipta007.github.io/OracleZoom/ .
articles.bodyZh:
递归超分（Recursive Super-Resolution, SR）的思路很简单：把固定倍率的超分模型反复套用，让模型输出的图片再塞回自己继续放大，就好比你反复缩放同一张照片，一点点抠细节。但问题来了——每一级放大都需要对应的高清真实图当“标准答案”，尤其是往更深层走，需要的源图分辨率会按几何倍数暴涨，很多时候根本拿不到真实参考，导致深层预测基本处于“没老师管”的状态。

我们提出的OracleZoom，借鉴了“在线策略蒸馏”（on-policy distillation）的思路，让模型沿着自己生成的轨迹边跑边学，同时把最后一张真实参考图的信息一路带过监督边界，让更深的层也有据可依。具体来说，直接监督和跨尺度监督用来约束那些有真实参考可验证的内容；而没法靠参考校对的细小纹理，就交给一种“无参考”的质量目标来引导优化。

为了避免模型光顾着把画面变“好看”而跑偏，我们额外引入了一个带KL约束的预训练潜在先验（latent prior）来稳住生成方向；同时用EMA（指数移动平均）一致性策略让监督边界附近的训练更稳定。

在七个数据集上，OracleZoom在不同缩放倍率下都达到了目前最好的超分质量，平均CLIPIQA分数达到0.713，尤其是越深的放大层次优势越明显，同时大幅减少了模型“脑补”出的虚假细节（hallucination）。代码、数据和模型都已公开：https://dipta007.github.io/OracleZoom/

articles.title: Power Mean Estimation in Stochastic Continuous Monte Carlo Tree Search
articles.zh: 随机连续蒙特卡洛树搜索中的幂均值估计
articles.summary: 如果你在用MCTS做连续动作空间规划，这篇告诉你如何用幂均值更稳地估计节点价值，少调随机种子
articles.author: Tuan Dam
articles.body: Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) has demonstrated success in online planning for deterministic environments, yet significant challenges remain in adapting it to stochastic Markov Decision Processes (MDPs), particularly in continuous state-action spaces. Existing methods, such as HOOT, which combines MCTS with the Hierarchical Optimistic Optimization (HOO) bandit strategy, address continuous spaces but rely on a logarithmic exploration bonus that lacks theoretical guarantees in non-stationary, stochastic settings. Recent advancements, such as POLY-HOOT, introduced a polynomial bonus term to achieve convergence in deterministic MDPs, though a similar theory for stochastic MDPs remains undeveloped. In this paper, we propose a novel MCTS algorithm, \Algname, designed for continuous, stochastic MDPs. \Algname integrates a power mean as a value backup operator, alongside a polynomial exploration bonus to address the non-stationarity inherent in continuous action spaces. Our theoretical analysis establishes that \Algname converges at a polynomial rate of $\mathcal{O}(n^{-ζ})$, $ζ\in (0,1/2)$, where \( n \) is the number of visited trajectories, thereby extending the non-asymptotic convergence guarantees of POLY-HOOT to stochastic environments. Experimental results on stochastic tasks validate our theoretical findings, demonstrating the effectiveness of \Algname in continuous, stochastic domains.
articles.bodyZh: 蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）在确定性环境下的在线规划中已经证明了它的成功，但要把它推广到随机马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）上，还面临不少难题，尤其是在连续状态-动作空间里。现有的方法，比如HOOT——它把MCTS和分层乐观优化（HOO）这种老虎机策略结合起来——确实能处理连续空间，但它用的那种对数形式的探索奖励，在非平稳、随机的场景下缺乏理论保证。后来又有了一些进展，比如POLY-HOOT，它引入了一个多项式形式的奖励项，在确定性MDP里实现了收敛，不过针对随机MDP的类似理论至今还没做出来。在这篇论文里，我们提出了一种新的MCTS算法，叫\Algname，专门为连续、随机的MDP设计。\Algname把幂均值（power mean）当作价值回传算子，同时搭配一个多项式探索奖励，来解决连续动作空间里固有的非平稳性问题。我们的理论分析证明，\Algname以多项式速率$\mathcal{O}(n^{-ζ})$收敛，其中$ζ\in (0,1/2)$，$n$是已访问的轨迹数量，这样一来，就把POLY-HOOT的有限时间收敛保证扩展到了随机环境里。我们在随机任务上做的实验结果验证了我们的理论推导，也展示了\Algname在连续、随机场景下的实际效果。

articles.title: Second-Order Smooth Planning with Optimal-Transport Bellman Smoothing
articles.zh: 基于最优传输Bellman平滑的二阶平滑规划
articles.summary: 如果你在做机器人运动规划或连续控制，这个二阶平滑方法能帮你避免轨迹抖动，但实现复杂度要先掂量
articles.author: Tuan Dam
articles.body: Planning with a generative model aims to estimate the value of a state using as few simulator calls as possible. SmoothCruiser achieves problem-independent complexity $\widetilde O(\varepsilon^{-4})$ by exploiting the smoothness of the entropy-regularized Bellman backup, but its estimator is only first-order. We show that the sample-complexity exponent of SmoothCruiser-type planners is governed by the order $β$ of the local Taylor remainder, giving oracle complexity $\widetilde O(\varepsilon^{-(2+2/(β-1))})$: the first-order case $β=2$ recovers SmoothCruiser, while a second-order/cubic remainder $β=3$ yields $\widetilde O(\varepsilon^{-3})$. We reach this regime with an optimal-transport-smoothed Bellman backup over action distributions, which has a closed form, a policy gradient, and a Lipschitz Hessian, and whose quadratic correction admits an unbiased cross-product estimator. The resulting SecondOrderSmoothCruiser achieves $\widetilde O(\varepsilon^{-3})$ oracle complexity for fixed OT parameters, and we relate the OT, entropy-regularized, and unregularized objectives through explicit regularization-bias bounds.
articles.bodyZh: 使用生成模型（generative model）做规划的时候，目标很简单：尽量少调用模拟器（simulator），就能估算出某个状态的价值。SmoothCruiser 靠着熵正则化（entropy-regularized）的贝尔曼备份（Bellman backup）的平滑性，拿到了一个不依赖具体问题（problem-independent）的复杂度，也就是 $\widetilde O(\varepsilon^{-4})$；可惜它的估计器只用到了一阶（first-order）信息。我们证明了，SmoothCruiser 这类规划器的样本复杂度指数，其实是由局部泰勒余项（Taylor remainder）的阶数β决定的，最后得到 oracle 复杂度（oracle complexity，也就是对模拟器的调用复杂度）是 $\widetilde O(\varepsilon^{-(2+2/(\beta-1))})$：β=2 对应一阶情形，正好还原出 SmoothCruiser；如果余项能做到二阶甚至三阶，也就是β=3，复杂度就能达 $\widetilde O(\varepsilon^{-3})$。为了进入这个更优区间，我们在动作分布（action distributions）上引入了“最优传输平滑”的贝尔曼备份——它既有闭式解（closed form），又能做策略梯度（policy gradient），海森矩阵（Hessian）也是利普希茨（Lipschitz）连续的；而且这个备份的二次修正项能给出一个无偏的叉积估计器（cross-product estimator）。最终搞出来的 SecondOrderSmoothCruiser，在固定最优传输参数（OT parameters）的情况下，就达到了 $\widetilde O(\varepsilon^{-3})$ 的 oracle 复杂度。我们还给出了显式的正则化偏差界（regularization-bias bounds），把最优传输、熵正则化和无正则化这几种目标之间的关系彻底理清楚了。

articles.title: One MLLM, One Call: Efficient Zero-Shot Vision-and-Language Navigation via Spatial-Aware Waypoints
articles.zh: 单次调用单MLLM：基于空间感知路径点的零样本视觉语言导航
articles.summary: 如果你做具身智能或室内导航，这个只需一次大模型调用就能选路径点的方案，比多步Agent省时省token
articles.author: Shiqi Pan, Qi Zheng 等
articles.body: Vision-and-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments (VLN-CE) requires an embodied agent to navigate unseen environments by following natural language instructions. Current zero-shot VLN-CE methods either rely on pre-trained waypoint predictors or require multiple queries to large models per step. To address prohibitive inference latency and computational overhead, we propose O2C-Nav, an efficient zero-shot navigation framework that calls only a single large model once per decision step. Our approach introduces a training-free structured waypoint generator and a novel abstract representation that projects sparse, history-aware candidate waypoints directly onto RGB images as visual markers. The MLLM selects a waypoint or generates a fallback target bounding box at each step, while a low-level Fast Marching Method (FMM) planner converts the selected target into an executable collision-free path. This paradigm provides the model with concrete spatial perception and explicit memory while significantly reducing the visual processing load. Extensive evaluations on the R2R-CE and RxR-CE benchmarks demonstrate that O2C-Nav outperforms current state-of-the-art zero-shot methods, highlighting its great potential for real-time robotic deployment. Code is available at https://github.com/kkpsq/O2C-Nav-Code.
articles.bodyZh: VLN-CE（连续环境下的视觉-语言导航）这项任务，要求智能体（agent）在没见过的环境里，跟着自然语言指令自己找路。现阶段的零样本（zero-shot）VLN-CE方法，要么靠预训练好的航点预测器，要么每走一步就得对大型模型问上好几次。这就导致了推理延迟高、计算开销大。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了O2C-Nav——一个高效的零样本导航框架，每个决策步骤只需要调用一次大型模型。我们的方法引入了一个无需训练的结构化航点生成器，还设计了一种新颖的抽象表示：把稀疏的、带有历史信息的候选航点直接投射到RGB图像上，当作视觉标记。多模态大语言模型（MLLM）每一步从中选出一个航点，或者生成一个备选的目标边界框（bounding box）；底层再用快速行进法（Fast Marching Method, FMM）规划器，把选好的目标转换成一条可执行、无碰撞的路径。这样一来，模型既能获得具体的空间感知，也能拥有明确的记忆，同时大幅减少了视觉处理负担。我们在R2R-CE和RxR-CE两个基准上做了大量实验，结果显示O2C-Nav的性能超过了目前最先进的零样本方法，展现出它在机器人实时部署上的巨大潜力。代码已经开源在：https://github.com/kkpsq/O2C-Nav-Code。

articles.title: A Group-Based Resource Allocation Model for the Fractional Knapsack Problem
articles.zh: 面向分数背包问题的基于分组的资源分配模型
articles.summary: 如果你在做云资源分配或任务调度，这个分组式模型能把经典的分数背包扩展到更贴近真实约束的场景
articles.author: Abhinaba Chakraborty
articles.body: To solve the fractional knapsack problem, Dantzig's greedy rule orders items according to their value-to-cost ratio. This ordering introduces priority issues. An arbitrarily small perturbation to the input can change the allocation if the budget is exhausted between two items with very similar ratios. To mitigate that problem, we introduce a two-stage rule. We group items sharing attributes within a radius $δ$. These groups are then evaluated in descending order of ratio, and divide their group's budget share without further ranking. Consider a group featuring an aggregate capacity $U_G$, unit costs contained in $[w^-,w^+]$, and a representative value $\widehat{v}$. The group's loss compared to the exact optimum is bounded by $\widehat{v}\, U_G\frac{w^+-w^-}{w^++w^-}+\varepsilon_v U_G$, in which $\varepsilon_v$ limits the group's internal value variation. Moreover, for any group size, this harmonic factor remains tight. The overall loss becomes restricted to the single budget-binding group whenever the grouping remains order-compatible; thus, groups containing at most $K$ items suffer a per-item loss of $\mathcal{O}(K/n)$. Should group ratio intervals exhibit an overlap of at most $ω$, an additive term $ωC$ degrades this bound. Within the separation margin between adjacent groups, the grouped allocation remains Lipschitz continuous with respect to cost data, exhibiting a modulus of $\frac{K}{w_{\min}}$. Computing this allocation takes $\mathcal{O}(n+m\log m+|Γ|\log|Γ|)$ time given $m$ groups and a boundary group $Γ$. Alternatively, the time complexity drops to $\mathcal{O}(n+m\log m)$ if a linear-time selection method identifies the boundary group's allocation.
articles.bodyZh:
解决分数背包问题（fractional knapsack problem）时，丹齐格贪心规则（Dantzig's greedy rule）通常会按照物品的价值成本比（value-to-cost ratio）来排优先级。但这样排序会带来一个麻烦：如果预算刚好卡在了两个比值非常接近的物品之间，那么哪怕输入数据只有一丁点扰动，分配结果都可能大变样。

为了缓解这个问题，我们提出了一种两阶段规则。先把一些属性相近的物品归成一组，组内属性差距不超过半径 δ；然后按组与组的比值从高到低处理顺序，但组内不再进一步排名，而是整组去分属于自己那份预算。假设某个组的总容量是 U_G，单位成本落在 [w^-, w^+] 之间，还有一个代表值 v̂。那么，和精确最优解相比，这一组的损失上界是 v̂ U_G (w^+-w^-)/(w^+ + w^-) + ε_v U_G，其中 ε_v 用来限制组内价值的变化幅度。而且不管组分多大，这个调和因子（harmonic factor）都是紧的。

只要分组保持顺序兼容（order-compatible），整体损失就会被局限在唯一那个“卡预算”的组上。所以，包含最多 K 个物品的组，单个物品的损失只有 O(K/n)。万一相邻组的比值区间出现交叠，最大交叠量为 ω，那么之前那个界还要再添一个加项 ωC，效果是让上界变差一点。在相邻组之间的间隔区域内，分组后的分配方案对成本数据具有利普希茨连续性（Lipschitz continuity），其模量为 K/w_min。给定 m 个组和一个边界组（boundary group）Γ，算这个分配的时间复杂度是 O(n + m log m + |Γ| log |Γ|)。如果改用线性时间选择方法来确定边界组的分配，时间复杂度还能降到 O(n + m log m)。

articles.title: One Step, One Lead: Mitigating Higher-Order Interference in Multi-Domain Reinforcement Learning via Cross-Step Control
articles.zh: 一步一引导：通过跨步控制缓解多域强化学习中的高阶干扰
articles.summary: 如果你在多任务或多域强化学习里被训练互相干扰搞到头大，这个跨步控制技巧可以帮你压住高阶串扰
articles.author: Zihan Lin, Xiaohan Wang 等
articles.body: Reinforcement learning (RL) across multiple domains can broaden the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs), yet joint training often degrades individual-domain performance and can destabilize optimization. Existing work typically diagnoses such interference from a single-step view using first-order gradient alignment or curvature-based proxies. We show that this view can miss a critical form of sequential interference: same-point domain gradients may remain nearly orthogonal even when consecutive realized updates partially reverse one another in output space. We further show that consecutive token log-probability footprints recover this interaction directly from adjacent checkpoints as a local second-order interaction in output space, without explicitly reconstructing same-step curvature. Building on this insight, we propose OSOL, which designates a focus domain at each iteration, uses the preceding checkpoint footprint to rank token-level rebound risk, and applies a drift-ranked, adaptively scaled correction within the standard GRPO update. Our analysis shows that this correction suppresses the targeted cross-step output backtracking component. Controlled studies further show that cross-step backtracking is more strongly associated with subsequent task damage than same-point gradient diagnostics, while the preceding footprint ranks future rebound risk more accurately than Hessian-based proxies. On Qwen3-30B-A3B, OSOL reaches a domain-macro average of 0.4822, improving by 5.7% over the strongest compared baseline, without explicit higher-order differentiation.
articles.bodyZh:
强化学习（Reinforcement Learning, RL）在多个领域上一起训练，确实能让大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）想问题想得更全面，但问题是，联合训练常常会把单个领域的表现拉下来，还会让优化过程不稳定。现有的研究一般是从单步视角去诊断这种干扰，用的办法要么是一阶梯度对齐（first-order gradient alignment），要么是基于曲率的近似指标（curvature-based proxies）。我们要说的是，这种视角其实会漏掉一种很关键的“顺序干扰”：两个领域在同一点上的梯度可能看起来几乎是正交的，并不会冲突，但真正连续更新的时候，前后两步实际更新的方向，在输出空间里却可能互相抵消了一部分。

我们进一步发现，利用相邻两个检查点（checkpoint）之间、连续token的对数概率足迹（log-probability footprints），可以直接捕捉到这种相互作用，这其实是一种输出空间里的局部二阶交互效应，我们不需要显式地重建同一步的曲率信息。基于这个发现，我们提出了一个方法叫OSOL。它的做法是：每次迭代时先指定一个重点领域（focus domain），然后利用前一个检查点的足迹来给token级别的“回弹风险”排序，再在标准GRPO更新里加一个按漂移排序、自适应缩放的修正项。我们的分析表明，这个修正确实能压住那种跨步骤的输出回退（cross-step output backtracking）分量。

控制实验也说明，跨步骤回退相比同点梯度诊断，更能预示后续对任务造成的损害；而用前一个检查点的足迹去预测未来回弹风险，也比基于Hessian的代理指标更准。在Qwen3-30B-A3B模型上，OSOL的领域宏平均分数达到了0.4822，比最强的对比基线提升了5.7%，而且完全没有做显式的高阶微分。
